_comment: Single source of truth for model pricing. USD per 1M tokens, Amazon Bedrock on-demand, us-east-1 / US cross-region inference profiles (verified against Cost Explorer usage-type unit rates, 2026-09-03; Bedrock = Anthropic first-party +10%). Keys match gen_ai.request.model values seen in spans - both bare model names (Claude Code CLI) and Bedrock inference-profile ids (Strands personas). cachedInputDiscount = cache-read rate as a fraction of input. cacheWriteMultiplier = cache-write rate as a multiple of input, keyed by hub.cache_ttl (5m|1h) with a default fallback (added TEAM-3954). kiro.usdPerCredit converts Kiro credits (its only usage unit) to USD for cross-engine comparison. MERGE-APPROVAL NOTES (TEAM-3954, values on this branch differ from the epic spec's anchors - flagged, NOT overwritten): (1) main carries claude-fable-5-1 keys at 20/100 (TEAM-3849); this branch adds them at 11/55 per the epic spec and #328's Cost-Explorer-verified basis. Human Merge Approval gate must confirm which value wins - changing fable pricing alters reported persona cost. (The keys are required because the runtime default MODEL_ID is us.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1, which would otherwise fall through to `default` 5.5/27.5 - silently wrong persona cost, AC-J2.) (2) the epic spec claimed suffixed haiku keys were 0.8/4 and warned the new bare key at 1.1/5.5 would conflict; on this branch the suffixed haiku keys are ALREADY 1.1/5.5, so the new bare 'us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001' key at 1.1/5.5 is consistent - no conflict.

cacheWriteMultiplier._basis: Bedrock prompt-cache write surcharge as a multiple of the base input rate: 5-minute cache = 1.25x, 1-hour cache = 2x input (Anthropic on-demand cache-write pricing). Keyed by the span's hub.cache_ttl (TEAM-3953); 'default' applies when ttl is absent/unknown (e.g. coding-CLI usage records).

kiro._basis: Kiro Pro $20/mo / 1000 credits (lowest public tier, per aws.amazon.com/q/developer/faqs); overage rate is $0.04/credit

agentcore._basis: AgentCore Runtime consumption pricing us-east-1, verified against Cost Explorer unit rates 2026-09
